== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[A Step Backward & Higher Ground (V)]] (<code>1282_23</code>, Virtual Block 8.2), showing the '''PC-E1 (title)''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The new title over the art of A Step Backward (Tatooine), the card the slip is pasted over after the retitle; the game text is unchanged.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p879652 by Lukes Bionic Hand, 2 May 2014: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p879652
* '''PC-E1 (title) text:''' “During a battle at opponent's site (or your non-<> site), instead of firing one of your character weapons at a target, cause that target to be immunity to attrition -3 (or limited to immunity to attrition < 5) for remainder of turn. OR Find one of your missing characters. OR Cancel a 'react.' OR Once per game, use 1 Force to exchange a card in hand with the top most character of ability < 5 in your Lost Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E1 (title) game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB8-03-Found_Someone_You_Have_Higher_Ground-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
